trust_decision.summary: Two decisions: (1) is a record payload a Python literal before it is stored (parse_record_literal at every record-field set site), and (2) does the caller hold 'senaite.core: Access JSON API' on the object it is about to change (check_jsonapi_permission in each JSON API route).

landing_point.why: The summary says 'Eval Injection and Missing Authorization'; the only eval fed by request form values is set_fields_from_request (src/bika/lims/jsonapi/__init__.py:199-240), reached from /@@API/update. It is a partial decoy: the branch at lines 237-238 only matches the exact base dotted type names, so the documented PoC field AddressField('PostalAddress', src/bika/lims/content/person.py:196-202) skips it and reaches the second eval in RecordField.set (src/senaite/core/browser/fields/record.py:256) through field.set at line 250.

fix_sites.entry_point: RecordField.set() - AT form processing via RecordWidget, Genericsetup import, JSON API fallthrough at src/bika/lims/jsonapi/__init__.py:250
RecordsField._to_dict() via inherited RecordField.set (RecordsWidget form, GS import, JSON API)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: A solver can argue the remaining ungated routes (/@@API/read, /@@API/allowedTransitionsFor_many) are read-only lookups needed by the anonymous reference-widget/listing UI, so the advisory's 'state-changing routes' wording leaves them out.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Records are legitimately stored and round-tripped as single-quoted Python reprs, and multivalued/legacy payloads arrive already parsed or joined by '}newline'; swapping in json.loads (rejects single quotes), rejecting non-literals, or dropping the except-swallow breaks the RecordsWidget hidden-input round trip, Genericsetup export/import (the exported repr string re-enters field.set) and multivalued @@API updates. Codebase-wide, calculation formulas are deliberate Python eval and must keep evaluating.

O6_input_shapes: newline-joined multi-record string, normalize_records replaces '}newline' with '},' before parsing (src/senaite/core/browser/fields/records.py:138-142; fix.diff:61-64)
value already parsed / not a string: dict or list from 'FieldName:list' or a preset record, returned unchanged (fix.diff:58-59; src/bika/lims/jsonapi/__init__.py:209-227)
expression payload that is not a literal, e.g. __import__('os').system(...), rejected (fix.diff:64; fix.diff:140-147)

record-field subclass whose registered type is not the base dotted name, so the JSON API eval branch is skipped and the raw string reaches RecordField.set (src/bika/lims/jsonapi/__init__.py:237-238; src/bika/lims/browser/fields/addressfield.py:25-33)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: /@@API/read: returns every object's fields and, via include_methods, invokes arbitrary zero-arg methods on any object with no AccessJSONAPI check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: 'read' is the read-only catalog lookup the public reference-widget/listing UI uses; the advisory speaks of state-changing routes, and its own include_methods feature is documented as data extraction.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: same package and same file as the landing point (0 files)

O8_uncovered_routes.route: /@@API/allowedTransitionsFor_many: returns allowed workflow transitions for any UID with no AccessJSONAPI check
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: read-only workflow metadata that mutates nothing; a neighbouring feature to the gated doActionFor route.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a new IRouteProvider route (e.g. /@@API/patch) registered next to doactionfor and allowedtransitionsfor
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: the registry is a flat list and every state-changing provider was added without the gate; a new provider inherits the omission.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a third bulk mutator that resolves objects with restrictedTraverse and calls set_fields_from_request
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: update_many already has exactly this shape; a maintainer adding another bulk mutator would copy it, including the pre-fix absence of a permission check.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: another RecordField subclass (location, result-range, duration) with its own registered type that inherits set()
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: eight such subclasses already exist under src/bika/lims/browser/fields/; each sets its own type and inherits the parsing, so the JSON API branch at src/bika/lims/jsonapi/__init__.py:237-238 skips it and the raw string reaches RecordField.set.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: a second Genericsetup node adapter that feeds record strings into field.set on import
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: ATRecordFieldNodeAdapter is a one-line subclass and every field type already has its own adapter, so a new record-bearing field gets one by default.

O9_family: CWE-95 expression/code injection (eval of record payloads) and CWE-862 missing authorization on JSON API routes
